doc.name: AgentDrives
doc.description: Use when you or the user must choose a tool, API or provider for a task: ask AgentDrives which software an AI agent can use, from our agent's test drives. Find products for a task, search the directory, get one product's listing, or ask for a product to be driven, free. Send a data part {"skill": "<id>", …arguments} or plain text (a search).

apiKeySecurityScheme.name: x-api-key
apiKeySecurityScheme.description: Optional. Your AgentDrives API key (https://agentdrives.com/app/keys, or POST https://agentdrives.com/api/agents/signup). The verified owner of a product's domain gets that product's drive detail with get_tool.

skills.name: Find tools for a task
skills.description: Use when a tool, API or provider must be chosen for a task: products an agent can use for the task in plain words, ranked by how far our agent got doing it: each with its level (0-5), the closest task we tried and how it went, where it stopped, and links to sign up, the docs and its MCP server. A product listed, not driven comes after, as status listed with no level. None we drove or listed does it: the nearest category and how to ask for a drive. The same answer as the MCP tool choose_provider_for_task. Arguments: task, capability, category, self_signup, min_level, surface, access, pays_with, limit, brief.

skills.name: Search the directory
skills.description: Use when you have a product's name, domain or kind in mind: products we drove that match a query, category, minimum agent level (0-5), way in or payment rail, each with its level, where our agent stopped and its page. The same answer as the MCP tool search_tools. Arguments: query, category, min_level, agent_can_buy, agent_can_leave, pays_with, access, surface, limit, offset.

skills.name: Get one product's listing
skills.description: Use when you are about to use or recommend a product: its result by its slug, name or domain: its level, how far an agent gets and where it stops, what it can and can't do, tips for agents. The same answer as the MCP tool get_provider (brief: true for the headline). With the x-api-key of the product's verified owner, its drive detail too. Arguments: slug, brief.

skills.name: Ask for a free drive
skills.description: Name a product for our agent to drive and list, free: the same as the site's "Suggest a product" form. Arguments: url, why.
